patch:
diff --git a/core/compiler/x64.jo b/core/compiler/x64.jo
index ef02a939..fc7d3360 100644
--- a/core/compiler/x64.jo
+++ b/core/compiler/x64.jo
@@ -408,22 +408,33 @@ analyze = ():
             v_ndef[v] = 1
             vloc[v] = LOC_CONST
             vcval[v] = ir.kval[v]
+    # These five buffers were freshly allocated above, all with nv elements.
+    # They are neither shared nor resized in this pass. Check each IR register
+    # once before accessing their private storage, rather than repeating the
+    # same bounds and copy-on-write checks for every field of its live range.
+    first = data(v_first) as *int
+    last = data(v_last) as *int
+    ndef = data(v_ndef) as *int
+    nuse = data(v_nuse) as *int
+    weight = data(v_weight) as *int
     depth = 0
     loop pos in 0.. and ins in ir.code:
         d = ir_operands(ins)
         w = 1 << (3 * min(depth, 6))
         loop operand_index in [0..ir_use_count):
             let u = ir_use(operand_index)
-            if pos < v_first[u]: v_first[u] = pos
-            if pos > v_last[u]: v_last[u] = pos
-            v_nuse[u] += 1
-            v_weight[u] += w
+            if u < 0 or u >= nv: panic("invalid operand register in native analysis")
+            if pos < first[u]: first[u] = pos
+            if pos > last[u]: last[u] = pos
+            nuse[u] += 1
+            weight[u] += w
         if d >= 0:
-            if pos < v_first[d]: v_first[d] = pos
-            if pos > v_last[d]: v_last[d] = pos
-            v_ndef[d] += 1
-            v_weight[d] += w
-            if v_ndef[d] == 1:
+            if d >= nv: panic("invalid destination register in native analysis")
+            if pos < first[d]: first[d] = pos
+            if pos > last[d]: last[d] = pos
+            ndef[d] += 1
+            weight[d] += w
+            if ndef[d] == 1:
                 op = ins.op
                 if op == .iconst and fits32(ins.imm):
                     vloc[d] = LOC_CONST
@@ -438,7 +449,7 @@ analyze = ():
                     vloc[d] = LOC_GLOBAL
                     vgoff[d] = int(ins.imm)
                     if op == .gaddr: vgkind[d] = 1
-                else if op == .add and vloc[int(ins.a)] == LOC_SLOT and vloc[int(ins.b)] == LOC_CONST and v_ndef[int(ins.a)] == 1 and v_ndef[int(ins.b)] == 1:
+                else if op == .add and vloc[int(ins.a)] == LOC_SLOT and vloc[int(ins.b)] == LOC_CONST and ndef[int(ins.a)] == 1 and ndef[int(ins.b)] == 1:
                     vloc[d] = LOC_SLOT
                     vslot[d] = vslot[int(ins.a)]
                     vsoff[d] = vsoff[int(ins.a)] + vcval[int(ins.b)]
reason: Only 0.65–0.79% fewer retired instructions across three workloads. This narrow result does not justify additional pointer-lifetime invariants or a full stage campaign; no latency pilot/full gate was run. Seeking larger sources of repeated work.
